wd.title: Words & language
wd.sub: Every word the shop shows, in English and Bengali. Change any of them; your word wins over the shop's.
wd.note: An empty box gives the shop's own word back, so nothing is lost. Words with {name} keep those parts: the shop fills them in. A word you write with a number, a date or "this week" is yours to change when it stops being true.
wd.summary: {total} words · {changed} changed by you · {untr} with Bengali still in English
wd.searchPh: A word in English or Bengali, or its key
wd.none: No word matches. Try fewer letters, or Everywhere and All words.
wd.claimSaved: It has a number or a time ("this week", "today"): change it when it stops being true.
wd.emptyHelp: Leave empty for the shop's word.
wd.saved: Saved. The shop shows it now.
wd.readOnly: You can see these words. Changing them needs the permission "Change any word the shop shows".
wd.fileSub: Download every word as a CSV file, change it in a spreadsheet, then bring it back. Only the English and Bengali columns (your words) are read; an empty cell gives the shop's word back.

err.INVALID_INPUT: Not saved: a word is too long (300 letters at most) or uses a {part} the shop's word does not have: {details}
err.STALE: Not saved: someone saved words in between. Reload the page and try again.
err.CSV_SYNTAX: Not imported: a quote is not closed (line {details}).
err.CSV_COLUMNS: Not imported: the file needs the columns key and english or bengali.
err.CSV_KEYS: Not imported: these lines name no word of the shop: {details}
err.forbidden: You do not have permission to change words.
err.unauthorized: You were signed out. Sign in again.

grp.cardQuick: Quick add on a product card

fe.d: Open a shop page with a panel of its words: tap a word on the page, change it in English and Bengali, see it in place, then Publish. Only signed-in staff who may change words see the panel.
fe.enabled: Edit words on the shop page
fe.enabledHelp: Off: no shop page loads anything for it.
fe.openHelp: Opens the home page in a new tab with the panel; move to any page from there. Switch it on and save first.
fe.readOnly: You can see this switch. Changing it needs the permission to change the shop's words.

adm.searchPh: A word in English or Bengali, its key or its file
adm.note: The words of the admin pages, as the app has them. Here they can be read and searched; changing them is not built yet, so they look the same for every staff member.
